tasks.do: Daar runs chop inside it (chop also runs alone and inside chaat): chop gets its play area from whoever hosts it (the frame's area for the host's sub-area), never the screen. Both daar.js and chop.js join; chaat (which also hosts chop) must stay unchanged: run its contract too. The game asks the frame for its play area and bottom row (Cook.Frame.area, see kitchen-frame.md) and lays out its room in shares of that play area, never screen or sheet numbers (Cook.view, innerWidth/innerHeight, worldToScreen/screenToWorld, 1600 or 900). The old sums are deleted in the same change. A frame option you need that is missing: add it to js/cook/frame.js and write it in kitchen-frame.md, without changing what chai gets.
